message.reasoning_content: Card 6: prices -2 next market. Round 5, I have no goods, competitors have 2 each. Lower prices hurt them, benefit... I have no goods to sell next market? Next round 6 market — I could produce. Lower prices bad for me too. But I've already voted? "post_vote", voted all true — my action now? Phase law, post_vote means vote already counted? Available actions still vote... but voted=true. Perhaps I'm president and can veto. Card 6 passed presumably. Lower prices -2 hurts rivals more? They hold goods 2 each; I hold 0. As president, veto card 6 would keep prices higher — rivals sell at higher prices. Wait, -2 prices passed benefits me by hurting rivals? Rivals hold goods, I don't; card passing lowers prices, rivals earn less. So don't veto.
